title: Letters & Report Re Herman Neumann

page_data.en:
CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
No.269.
S. L. D. 1913.
11 - 2 - 31.
SHANGHAI, 26-1-1930.

Sir,
I wish to acknowledge the receipt of
your letter of the 26th instant, No.S.B.
D.1913, regarding H.Neumann, and to thank
you for the information contained therein.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Consul-General.

R.C.Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
第269号。
S. L. D. 1913。
11 - 2 - 31。
上海，1930年1月26日。

先生：
谨此确认收到您本月26日关于H. Neumann（诺伊曼）的第S.B.D.1913号来函，并感谢其中所载信息。

顺致崇高敬意，
先生，
您忠实的仆人，
总领事。

R.C. Aiers 先生，
警务处副总监，
刑事及特别部门，
上海。

page_data.en:
S.B. D.1913
& S. B. D. 1913.
26 - 1 - 31.

January 26, 31.

Sir,

With reference to your letter,
No. 153, dated January 14, 1931, inquiries
show that Hermann Neumann has been employed,
since he arrived in Shanghai in 1923, i.. the
West Coast Insurance Co., 3 Canton Road, as an
agent. He seems to have a good reputation,
and there is nothing detrimental to his character
either in a political or moral way known to the
Municipal Police. No confirmation can be found
of the report that Neumann was engaged in forestry
work in Soviet Russia, but statements made by himself
indicate that he did undertake duties connected with
forestry during the war on behalf of the German
Army in a part of Russia which at that time was
occupied by the Force in question.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

S.B. D.1913
及 S. B. D. 1913。
26 - 1 - 31。

1931年1月26日。

先生：

关于您1931年1月14日第153号来函，经查询显示，Hermann Neumann（赫尔曼·诺伊曼）自1923年抵达上海以来，一直受雇于广东路3号的西海岸保险公司（West Coast Insurance Co.），担任代理人。他似乎声誉良好，工部局警务处在政治或道德方面均未掌握任何对其品格不利的信息。关于诺伊曼曾在苏俄从事林业工作的报告，未能找到确证，但他本人的陈述表明，在战争期间，他确实代表德国军队在当时被该部队占领的俄罗斯部分地区承担了与林业相关的职责。

顺致崇高敬意，
先生，
您忠实的仆人，

特别部门负责人

致荷兰驻上海总领事

File No. ——
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT    8. 2.    Station,
Date January 23, 1931.
Subject (in full) Letter from the Netherlands Consulate re Hermann Neumann.
Made by    and    Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.

Sir,
With reference to the attached letter dated
January 14th from the Netherlands Consulate re Hermann
Neumann, enquiries show that he arrived in Shanghai from
Africa in 1928. On his arrival here he secured a position
with the West Coast Insurance Coy, 3 Canton Road as an agent.
This position he still holds.
In conversation, Neumann has intimated that
during the Great War he was in charge of forests in the
part of Russia then occupied by German troops.
It is not known that he was ever connected with
forestry in Soviet Russia. There is nothing in Municipal
Police records to his detriment.

W. Duncan.
D. S. I.

D. C. (C. & S. Branches)

Reg. Letter in accordance
with attached draft please
J.H.
24/1/31.

档案编号 ——
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告    8. 2.    分局，
日期 1931年1月23日。
主题（全称） 荷兰领事馆关于 Hermann Neumann（赫尔曼·诺伊曼）的来信。
制作人    及    由警探长邓肯（D.S.I. Duncan）转呈。

先生：
关于附上的荷兰领事馆1月14日关于 Hermann Neumann（赫尔曼·诺伊曼）的来信，经查询显示，他于1928年从非洲抵达上海。抵沪后，他在广东路3号的西海岸保险公司（West Coast Insurance Coy）谋得代理人一职。他目前仍担任该职。
在谈话中，诺伊曼暗示，在世界大战期间，他负责管理当时被德军占领的俄罗斯部分地区的森林。
据知，他从未与苏俄的林业工作有任何关联。工部局警务处档案中没有任何对其不利的记录。

W. 邓肯。
警探长。

副总监（刑事及特别部门）

请按所附草稿登记回信
J.H.
1931年1月24日。

AAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 53

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
L. & S. B. REC.
S. D. D. 19/3.
" 15 - 1 - 31.
SHANGHAI, 14th January 1931

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that a certain Hermann
Neumann, a German, living at 80 Carter Road, is applying
to the Netherlands Indian Government for a concession for
the exploitation of forests in Borneo.

I would be much obliged to know whether this person
was ever connected with forestry in Soviet Russia and is
known to enjoy a good reputation, both from a political and
moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
Chinese Secretary.

R.C.Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

（批：* Sir,
No record in
Sp. Br. Reg.
Sir,
No record CR.
[Signature]
15/1）

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号 HOLLANDIA。

第53号

上海公共租界工部局
L. & S. B. 收件。
S. D. D. 19/3。
" 15 - 1 - 31。
上海，1931年1月14日

先生：

谨此告知，一位名叫 Hermann Neumann（赫尔曼·诺伊曼）的德国人，现居住于卡特路80号，正向荷属印度政府申请在婆罗洲开采森林资源的特许权。

如能获悉此人是否曾与苏俄的林业工作有关联，以及在政治和道德方面是否享有良好声誉，我将不胜感激。

顺致崇高敬意，
先生，
您忠实的仆人，
[签名]
华务秘书。

R.C. Aiers 先生，
警务处副总监，
刑事及特别部门，
上海。

（批注：* 先生，
特别部门登记册中无记录。
先生，
刑事登记处无记录。
[签名]
1月15日）
